question: What epithet is assigned to the weapon limb in the sequential limb-nyāsa?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate names for limbs in order.
The term atha signals the next item in the sequence.
The locative astrake specifies the weapon limb as the locus.
inference: The epithet Sarva-para-unmukta-mantra-chedini is designated for placement on the weapon limb.
uncertainties: Whether astrake refers to a distinct limb or the astranyāsa gesture is context-dependent.
plain_english: Then, on the weapon, [place the name] Sarva-para-unmukta-mantra-chedini, the cutter of all other released mantras.
